task.problem: Current self-host workflows execute the host PATH command "aios" while passing the persistent AIOS_REPO_ROOT as --repo. The supported host setup uses an editable AIOS-renew installation and intentionally performs no workflow checkout, so executable Python source can be coupled to the mutable persistent checkout. TASK-157 exposed the consequence: during correction continuation a not-yet-published candidate could affect later A3/A6 control behavior before Reviewer PASS and Publisher publication. Manual realignment to published main restored the intended control behavior, but destructive checkout/reset cannot become the steady-state solution because the persistent repository also owns Runtime state and valid execution lineage. AIOS therefore needs a separate transient Control Source Subject: exact published control code may operate on the existing persistent repository without changing which repository owns Runtime state, execution workspace, verification subject, transport, review, or publication.
